presets.name: everyday-code
presets.title: Everyday code
presets.forWho: Teams writing and reviewing ordinary application code every day.
presets.why: Clean Code decides readability questions; Refactoring adds the safe, small-step way to act on them.

presets.name: legacy-rescue
presets.title: Legacy rescue
presets.forWho: Changing code that has no tests, in a codebase you did not write.
presets.why: Working Effectively with Legacy Code gets the change under test first; Refactoring then restructures in small steps; Clean Code names what better looks like.

presets.name: backend-service
presets.title: Backend service
presets.forWho: Services and APIs that must survive production: structure, data and failure.
presets.why: Clean Architecture keeps the dependency direction; Release It! covers timeouts, retries and overload; Designing Data-Intensive Applications covers consistency and data flow.

presets.name: domain-model
presets.title: Domain model
presets.forWho: Business-rule-heavy code where the model of the domain is the hard part.
presets.why: DDD Distilled gives the pragmatic core of domain-driven design; Clean Architecture protects the model from frameworks; Refactoring evolves it safely.

presets.name: system-design
presets.title: System design
presets.forWho: Designing modules, APIs and boundaries before or while building them.
presets.why: A Philosophy of Software Design judges module depth and interfaces; Clean Architecture sets boundaries; Code Complete covers construction detail.
